scope.current_boundary: Teach multi-stage and reverse use of the established constant-acceleration equations in straight-line motion. Do not introduce falling-object modelling, gravitational acceleration or projectile methods.
scope.previous_boundary_used: Choosing and using an equation established individual equation selection, rearrangement and substitution. This lesson extends that work to linked stages and reverse order of solution.
scope.next_boundary_checked: Falling objects. Gravitational acceleration, free fall and their signs are reserved for the next lesson.

questions_visited.why_selected: Directly indexed first stage of a two-interval motion question.

questions_visited.why_selected: Directly indexed continuation of a two-interval motion question.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Use the values belonging to the first interval to calculate its displacement before moving to the next stage.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Keep the first interval separate and pass only its terminal velocity into the following stage.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Using a whole-journey time in a one-stage displacement calculation.
